**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** Reviewed the full agreement. Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment) covers notice, the Termination Date and the Termination Payment mechanic only. Sections 1.4/1.5 give in-term access to HDI's system and order export files, not post-termination return. Section 8 (Confidentiality) imposes non-disclosure but no return/export duty, and Section 10.7 survival lists Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 — none of which is an exit provision. No transition, exit, data return, export or deletion language exists anywhere.
- **Cure:** One inserted Section 4.3 after p0029 carrying exactly the three fallback elements — obligations triggered on expiration or termination, at least 90 days of transition assistance, and export/delivery of our Content, user information and other data within 30 days. No survival tail, cost or procedural boilerplate added, and preferred-only extras (six months at then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion) were deliberately omitted and flagged as the trade in the comment.
